abstain_reason: This node is a worked example illustrating that a programmatic-format context can still support clarifying questions through the function-call interface. It does not itself establish a normative rule: it shows one permitted configuration of an instruction and a response, and the surrounding document's normative force (if any) is carried by the instruction it exemplifies, not by this node. Encoding it as a rule would invent a permission the node does not state.
